body: Others options would be to give the Tauri a 3px white border *or* follow others app by placing it into an white rounded rectangle. I do prefer the second over all three options (including yours) because for a fast "build and try" example is the easiest.
I would love to close this issue. @AlveLarsson - what are your thoughts here?
Peww, never had a mac so can't tell the behaviour. If it fits see if a drop shadow helps increasing the hitbox
Is this something I could take a look at to pick up?
Are there any vectors available for the logo that I can build on? If not then I can just go based off the existing raster images
@AlveLarsson has the vectors. Please don't start with raster images if you can avoid it. :)

Below is a draft that I have so far using a standardised script I use for all my icons for a quick POC. Once I get the vectors I'll just run it through again (should get rid of the artefacts around the edges as well). Draft apps now match the other rounded icons in my dock :)

Thanks @AlveLarsson 
Btw, is there any specific place in the repo where static reference assets that don't necessarily get bundled in a release go? I'm thinking this would be a good item to put in there.

@AlveLarsson that one is a slightly different version than what currently exists. The one you sent looks to be the logo that's on [tauri.studio](https://tauri.studio/en/) so it might make more sense to use this version to align the visual design anyway. ![tauri-vector](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/15347255/141128352-62083578-ad4b-41ac-a9fb-418a70e3b968.png) Dock shot:
